name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-06-23, at wavelengths from 1.28 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
